title: Chapter 230
content:
Chapter 230

Not far from the camp of the coalition army, on an ordinary hill, there are many trees, luxuriant grass, and the surrounding scenery is pleasant. It is a good place for spring outing.

It's a pity that the bustling place that people used to come to in the past, because of the spread of the war, is now completely deserted. Even if there are a few people, there are only scouts from the two armies who come here occasionally.

But now, there is a rare group of people here, counting carefully, there are more than a hundred people.

If someone with sharp eyesight looked at them carefully, they would be able to find that all of these hundreds of people were all masters of the martial arts world with internal strength and strong martial arts.

At this time, in this environment, what is the purpose of these martial arts masters coming here?

Among these masters, especially the three stand out from the crowd, and the people around them should take them as the head and surround them endlessly.

I saw these three people staring at each other, looking towards the coalition army and the Qin army camp below, each in deep thought.

"Brother Xiaoyao, I don't know what you think of this coalition army, the joint commander of this coalition army?" Frowning, Tian Guang, the current hero of the farm family, looked at the two camps below, especially those in the direction of the coalition army, and finally said.

Opposite Tian Guang, dressed in a purple and white Taoist robe, holding the sword of the head of Taoism in his hand, Xue Ji, Xiaoyaozi, the famous sword in the world, was looking down at the moment, and suddenly heard Tian Guang's question , turned his head and opened his mouth to speak.

"Punish no way, conquer the Qin Dynasty. Since the reform of the Qin State, it has repeatedly provoked wars in the world, causing the people in the world to be displaced, starving and dying everywhere, and the flames of war continued, making the people of the whole world live in dire straits. It can be said to be extremely tyrannical! "Xiaoyaozi raised his eyebrows, and this sentence popped out of his mouth, which is also his consistent proposition.

"I know that Qin's tyranny is well known to everyone in the world. It is because of this that we will get together and plan to resist Qin. What I want to talk about now is the founder of this alliance, the current partner. Longer, what kind of person is he?" Tian Guang felt a little displeased, and he felt a little angry at Xiaoyaozi's cunning.

"He Zongchang, who is he? How should I say it? To be able to abandon the temptation of the territory and step into the huge bait of the Central Plains, instead choose the population that he urgently needs, and fundamentally weaken the strength of the entire Central Plains. This strategy, this This kind of choice is already higher than other countries!" Xiaoyaozi saw that he couldn't avoid it, so he had to say something, and in his words, he was full of admiration for Yuguo.

"Yes, it's really admirable to be able to take and give up, to advance and retreat, but what he did because of this, is it really different from Tyranny?" Tian Guang gritted his teeth and said what he said. However, he is full of dissatisfaction with this imperial country.

"Indeed, because of the emergence of Yuguo, there have been too many changes in the whole world. The entire Central Plains, and even most of the world, have become a mess. There are wars everywhere, people are displaced, and wars are fought year after year. After that, there seems to be no moment to stop!" Having said this, Xiaoyaozi also sighed a little.

The Renzong of Taoism has always been inclined to practice in the world, and it often attaches more importance to the safety of the people in the world and the happiness of all people. Seeing the chaos in the world now, Xiaoyaozi said in his heart that he was not sad, but he was joking.

Originally, they gathered together to boycott the Qin State because they had no way to tyrannize the Qin State.

For more than a hundred years, because of Qin's actions, countless people have been killed or injured. Not to mention anything else, let alone Bai Qi, who killed more than a million young and middle-aged men alone.

Such behavior, of course, aroused the anger of the people of the world.

First of all, how many people were killed or injured by Qin's conquest of the world? And how many of these people who died were relatives of various schools of thought? Or simply one of them?

Don't think of all the schools of thought too noble, even the Taoists who pay attention to tranquility and inaction also have their own emotions and desires. They practice the way of heaven, but they are not the way of heaven, they are still a person with their own ideas, so they have The difference between Tianzong and Renzong lies in the hundreds of years of struggle.

Among them, the peasant family with the largest number of people suffered a lot from it. The peasant family claimed to have 100,000 disciples. This number, before the war, was even equivalent to the entire military strength of South Korea.

The 100,000 disciples of the peasant family are distributed in all countries in the world, and their sphere of influence can be said to be the most extensive. It is inevitable that some of them will be affected by the war in Qin State, and lost countless disciples and their relatives.

Over the years, the accumulated deep hatred and interest competition have long been deeply ingrained in the hearts of both parties, and it is difficult to eliminate.

Therefore, the peasant family has always been the most hostile to Qin among all the countries in the world. Often, every action against Qin in the world is led by the peasant family.

It's just that what they want now is for all countries in the world to unite and fight against Qin. It has really come true now, but the results brought about really make them unhappy.

The Qin State was indeed repelled, and the forces were also severely controlled on the front line of Hangu Pass. Now as long as it is in these three battlefields, Qin State will be completely repelled. Then Qin State will completely retreat back to the Guanzhong area behind Hangu Pass. Without his decades of self-cultivation, it is impossible to recover.

However, the whole world is completely rotten because of this war that lasted for more than two years.

Countless people were displaced, their families were destroyed, and any man who could take up arms was forced to be dragged to the battlefield by the government to serve as cannon fodder on the front line.

Now, among all the countries in the world, apart from Qi State, which has not been affected, and Chu State, which is located in the south, has a vast territory and profound heritage, these two countries have been slightly affected.

In the other Three Kingdoms of Han, Zhao and Wei, the country is already empty, and every house is covered with white cloth. Looking around, except for some young children who are still waiting to be fed, there is no longer a man in sight.

This kind of desolate scene far exceeds any previous era. Xiaoyaozi and his party traveled continuously during the war, and what they did and saw was shocking and chilling.

Is this the result they want? Qin was repelled, but the people in the world did not feel peaceful because of it. On the contrary, they became more miserable and more people died.

That's why they chose this time? In this environment, the reason for coming to such a place where you can get close to the battlefield and wait and see the situation on the battlefield.

They want to really verify here, verify whether their thinking is really correct, is it really okay for the war to continue?

And the initiator of this war, this sudden appearance of Yuguo, a country from northern Xinjiang, is exactly the focus of their discussion.
